about: Feature announcements for the What's new strip, written by hand. Newest first; each needs a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a short text. 'link' is optional.

notes.text: Reported results added for the most-used datasets (MIT, XJTU, HUST, Tongji, NASA, Oxford, Sandia, ISU-ILCC, RWTH) and BatteryLife; the Metrics table shows the best 8
New 'Metrics' button on datasets with reported results: every number in one table, best first, with a fair ranking per benchmark
Filters are now compact dropdowns above the results, so the catalogue uses the full screen width
This 'What's new' strip, and a 'New' badge on datasets added in the last 30 days
Cite IonSense: copy a ready BibTeX reference for the IonSense-QKG paper
XJTU, HUST, Tongji (TJU) and MIT datasets now use their common names; search finds either name
First release dates for 77 datasets, with a 'Newest release' sort and a 'First released' filter
New 'Methods used in studies' filter, including quantum machine learning
Citation counts and weekly link checks for every dataset
Cell chemistry checked at source for every dataset, with the evidence shown
Reported results, ranked only when studies used the same test cells and metric
